message.entry: The "timemap" object is specified as a continuous-time mapping. "TimeMap" property cannot contain a negative element which implies integration (negative derivative) of the scheduling signal. Type "help timemap" for more information.
Only two "timemap" objects can be added together. Type "help timemap/plus" for more information.
Cannot add these two "timemap" objects. One object is in continuous time and the other is in discrete time.
Cannot {1} the timemap objects. Scheduling signal dimensions are different.
Some scheduling channel index is out of range. Type "help timemap" for more information.
Some scheduling channel indeces are double defined. Type "help timemap" for more information.
Scheduling signal "{1}" has two different units, namely '{2}' and '{3}'. Hence, it is not possible to add the two timemaps. Type "help timemap/plus" for more information.

Scheduling signal "{1}" has two different ranges, namely '[{2,number};{3,number}]' and '[{4,number};{5,number}]'. Hence, it is not possible to add the two timemaps. Type "help timemap/plus" for more information.
